q19756.en: The sign shown bans agricultural tractors.

explain.short: The tractor in the red ring means no agricultural machines, and a farm tractor is one of them.
explain.rule: 'Macchine agricole' (agricultural machines) like tractors may not pass, day and night. Every other vehicle may pass.
explain.trap: 'trattrici agricole' are farm tractors: exactly the vehicles the sign bans.

sceneParams.caption: Farm tractors may not pass

q19757.en: Where the sign shown is, snowploughs may pass.

explain.short: The sign bans only agricultural machines. A snowplough is not a farm machine, so it may pass.
explain.rule: 'Macchine agricole' (agricultural machines) like tractors may not pass, day and night. Every other vehicle may pass.
explain.trap: 'sgombraneve' (snowplough) works on roads, it is not an agricultural machine.

sceneParams.caption: Snowploughs are not farm machines: they pass

q19758.en: The sign shown is valid both by day and by night.

explain.short: A prohibition sign has no time limit unless a panel says so: it is valid all day and all night.
explain.rule: 'Macchine agricole' (agricultural machines) like tractors may not pass, day and night. Every other vehicle may pass.
explain.trap: 'sia di giorno che di notte' means 'both day and night': no hours are shown, so it always applies.

sceneParams.caption: Valid day and night

keywords.it: sia di giorno che di notte
keywords.en: both by day and by night

q19759.en: Where the sign shown is, operating machines used for road maintenance work may pass.

explain.short: Road-maintenance machines ('macchine operatrici') are not agricultural machines, so the sign does not ban them.
explain.rule: 'Macchine agricole' (agricultural machines) like tractors may not pass, day and night. Every other vehicle may pass.
explain.trap: 'macchine operatrici' (work machines for roads) are a different class from 'macchine agricole'.

sceneParams.caption: Road-work machines are not farm machines

q19760.en: The sign shown applies both to agricultural machines on tyres and to tracked ones.

explain.short: The ban covers every agricultural machine, whatever it moves on: tyres or tracks.
explain.rule: 'Macchine agricole' (agricultural machines) like tractors may not pass, day and night. Every other vehicle may pass.
explain.trap: 'gommate' (on rubber tyres) and 'cingolate' (on tracks): the sign makes no difference.

sceneParams.caption: Tyres or tracks: all farm machines banned

q19761.en: Where the sign shown is, motorcycles may pass.

explain.short: Only agricultural machines are banned. A motorcycle is not one, so it may pass.
explain.rule: 'Macchine agricole' (agricultural machines) like tractors may not pass, day and night. Every other vehicle may pass.
explain.trap: 'motocicli' (motorcycles) are not agricultural machines.

sceneParams.caption: Motorcycles may pass

q19762.en: Where the sign shown is, motor quadricycles may pass.

explain.short: Only agricultural machines are banned. A motor quadricycle is not one, so it may pass.
explain.rule: 'Macchine agricole' (agricultural machines) like tractors may not pass, day and night. Every other vehicle may pass.
explain.trap: 'quadricicli a motore' (small four-wheel motor vehicles) are not farm machines.

sceneParams.caption: Quadricycles may pass

q19763.en: Where the sign shown is, agricultural machines may pass.

explain.short: It is the opposite: the tractor in the red ring means agricultural machines may NOT pass.
explain.rule: 'Macchine agricole' (agricultural machines) like tractors may not pass, day and night. Every other vehicle may pass.
explain.trap: 'è consentito' (is allowed) is the trap: for farm machines it is forbidden.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: farm machines are banned here

q19764.en: Where the sign shown is, towing agricultural trailers with a total mass up to 1.5 tonnes is allowed.

explain.short: An agricultural trailer is pulled by a farm machine, and farm machines are banned. The sign has no weight exception.
explain.rule: 'Macchine agricole' (agricultural machines) like tractors may not pass, day and night. Every other vehicle may pass.
explain.trap: 'fino a 1,5 tonnellate' (up to 1.5 tonnes) is an invented exception: the sign gives no weights.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: no exception for light farm trailers

q19765.en: The sign shown bans road tractors for semi-trailers.

explain.short: A road tractor for semi-trailers is the front part of an articulated lorry, not a farm machine, so it may pass.
explain.rule: 'Macchine agricole' (agricultural machines) like tractors may not pass, day and night. Every other vehicle may pass.
explain.trap: 'trattori stradali' (road tractor units of lorries) sound like farm tractors, but they are not.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: lorry tractor units are not banned

q19766.en: The sign shown bans motor quadricycles.

explain.short: Only agricultural machines are banned. Motor quadricycles may pass.
explain.rule: 'Macchine agricole' (agricultural machines) like tractors may not pass, day and night. Every other vehicle may pass.
explain.trap: 'quadricicli a motore' are not farm machines, so 'vieta' (bans) is wrong for them.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: quadricycles may pass

q19767.en: The sign shown is compulsory at private entrances.

explain.short: No rule asks for this sign at private entrances. It is placed where a road is closed to farm machines.
explain.rule: 'Macchine agricole' (agricultural machines) like tractors may not pass, day and night. Every other vehicle may pass.
explain.trap: 'obbligatorio' (compulsory) is invented: nothing requires it at 'accessi privati' (private entrances).

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: not required at private entrances

q19768.en: The sign shown is found only on the road network of farms.

explain.short: The sign is used on public roads, where farm machines are not allowed. It is not limited to farm roads.
explain.rule: 'Macchine agricole' (agricultural machines) like tractors may not pass, day and night. Every other vehicle may pass.
explain.trap: 'soltanto' (only) is the trap: the sign is on normal public roads.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: it is on public roads

q19769.en: Where the sign shown is, agricultural machines may pass during fairs.

explain.short: The sign has no exception for fairs. Farm machines may never pass, unless a panel says otherwise.
explain.rule: 'Macchine agricole' (agricultural machines) like tractors may not pass, day and night. Every other vehicle may pass.
explain.trap: 'durante le fiere' (during fairs) is an invented exception.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: no exception for fairs

q19770.en: The sign shown bans vehicles carrying dangerous goods.

explain.short: The orange plate is the mark of dangerous-goods vehicles: the red ring bans them.
explain.rule: Vehicles carrying 'merci pericolose' (dangerous goods), the ones with the orange plate, may not pass.
explain.trap: 'merci pericolose' (dangerous goods) is exactly what the orange plate stands for.

sceneParams.caption: No vehicles with dangerous goods

q19771.en: The sign shown bans tankers carrying petrol.

explain.short: Petrol is a dangerous good, so a petrol tanker is banned by this sign.
explain.rule: Vehicles carrying 'merci pericolose' (dangerous goods), the ones with the orange plate, may not pass.
explain.trap: 'autocisterne che trasportano benzina' (petrol tankers) carry dangerous goods.

sceneParams.caption: Petrol tankers are banned

q19772.en: The sign shown bans vehicles carrying slaughtered meat.

explain.short: Meat is not a dangerous good. The sign bans only vehicles with dangerous goods.
explain.rule: Vehicles carrying 'merci pericolose' (dangerous goods), the ones with the orange plate, may not pass.
explain.trap: 'carni macellate' (slaughtered meat) is food, not dangerous goods.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: only dangerous goods are banned

q19773.en: The sign shown bans motor vehicles with an engine running on liquid gas (LPG).

explain.short: The sign is about the LOAD, not the fuel. A car running on LPG carries no dangerous goods, so it may pass.
explain.rule: Vehicles carrying 'merci pericolose' (dangerous goods), the ones with the orange plate, may not pass.
explain.trap: 'motore alimentato a gas liquido' (engine running on LPG) is about fuel, not about the goods carried.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: LPG cars may pass; only the load counts

q19774.en: The sign shown bans canvas-covered lorries.

explain.short: A canvas cover says nothing about the load. Only vehicles with dangerous goods are banned.
explain.rule: Vehicles carrying 'merci pericolose' (dangerous goods), the ones with the orange plate, may not pass.
explain.trap: 'telonati' (with a canvas cover) describes the lorry, not dangerous goods.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: only dangerous goods are banned

q19775.en: The sign shown bans vehicles carrying perishable goods.

explain.short: Perishable goods (that go bad quickly) are not dangerous goods, so they are not banned.
explain.rule: Vehicles carrying 'merci pericolose' (dangerous goods), the ones with the orange plate, may not pass.
explain.trap: 'merci deperibili' (perishable goods) is not the same as 'merci pericolose' (dangerous goods).

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: perishable is not dangerous

q19776.en: The sign shown bans vehicles with a refrigerated van body.

explain.short: A refrigerated van carries cold food, not dangerous goods. The orange plate is not a fridge.
explain.rule: Vehicles carrying 'merci pericolose' (dangerous goods), the ones with the orange plate, may not pass.
explain.trap: 'furgone frigorifero' (refrigerated van) is about the vehicle, not dangerous goods.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: refrigerated vans may pass

q19777.en: The sign shown bans vehicles carrying explosives.

explain.short: The flame above the car means explosive or easily flammable loads: those vehicles may not pass.
explain.rule: Vehicles carrying explosives or 'prodotti facilmente infiammabili' (easily flammable products) may not pass. Fuel in the vehicle's own tank does not count.
explain.trap: 'esplosivi' (explosives) are exactly what the flame on the sign shows.

sceneParams.caption: No vehicles carrying explosives

q19778.en: The fuel in the vehicle's tank is not considered transport of flammable material banned by the sign in the figure.

explain.short: The sign is about the load. The fuel the vehicle needs to run is in its own tank and does not count.
explain.rule: Vehicles carrying explosives or 'prodotti facilmente infiammabili' (easily flammable products) may not pass. Fuel in the vehicle's own tank does not count.
explain.trap: 'non si considera' (is not considered): the fuel in the tank is not a load.

sceneParams.caption: Fuel in your own tank does not count

q19779.en: Where the sign shown is, cars running on methane may pass.

explain.short: Methane in the car's own tank is fuel, not a load, so the car may pass.
explain.rule: Vehicles carrying explosives or 'prodotti facilmente infiammabili' (easily flammable products) may not pass. Fuel in the vehicle's own tank does not count.
explain.trap: 'alimentate a metano' (running on methane) is about fuel, not about the load.

sceneParams.caption: Methane cars may pass

q19780.en: The sign shown bans vehicles carrying easily flammable products.

explain.short: The flame means explosive or easily flammable loads: those vehicles may not pass.
explain.rule: Vehicles carrying explosives or 'prodotti facilmente infiammabili' (easily flammable products) may not pass. Fuel in the vehicle's own tank does not count.
explain.trap: 'facilmente infiammabili' (easily flammable) is what the flame on the sign means.

sceneParams.caption: No vehicles with flammable loads

q19781.en: Where the sign shown is, motor vehicles carrying explosives may overtake.

explain.short: Vehicles carrying explosives may not even pass on this road, so they certainly cannot overtake there.
explain.rule: Vehicles carrying explosives or 'prodotti facilmente infiammabili' (easily flammable products) may not pass. Fuel in the vehicle's own tank does not count.
explain.trap: 'possono effettuare manovre di sorpasso' (may overtake): they may not even drive there.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: they may not even drive here

q19782.en: The sign shown tells you to pay attention to vehicles carrying explosives.

explain.short: It is a ban, not a warning: vehicles carrying explosives may not pass at all.
explain.rule: Vehicles carrying explosives or 'prodotti facilmente infiammabili' (easily flammable products) may not pass. Fuel in the vehicle's own tank does not count.
explain.trap: 'fare attenzione' (pay attention) is the wording of danger signs; this red ring is a prohibition.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: it is a ban, not a warning

q19783.en: Where the sign shown is, vehicles carrying easily flammable products may pass, as long as they are not explosive.

explain.short: The sign bans BOTH explosives and easily flammable products. Being 'not explosive' does not help.
explain.rule: Vehicles carrying explosives or 'prodotti facilmente infiammabili' (easily flammable products) may not pass. Fuel in the vehicle's own tank does not count.
explain.trap: 'purché non esplosivi' (as long as not explosive) is an invented condition.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: flammable loads are banned too

q19784.en: Where the sign shown is, towing vehicles that carry easily flammable products is allowed.

explain.short: A towed vehicle with a flammable load is still on the road with that load, so it is banned too.
explain.rule: Vehicles carrying explosives or 'prodotti facilmente infiammabili' (easily flammable products) may not pass. Fuel in the vehicle's own tank does not count.
explain.trap: 'traino' (towing) does not change anything: the flammable load is still there.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: towed or not, the load is banned

q19785.en: The sign shown bans vehicles carrying substances that can pollute water.

explain.short: The tanker over blue waves means loads that can pollute water: those vehicles may not pass.
explain.rule: Vehicles carrying substances that can 'contaminare l'acqua' (pollute water) may not pass. Other vehicles may.
explain.trap: 'suscettibili di contaminare l'acqua' means 'able to pollute water'.

sceneParams.caption: No loads that can pollute water

q19786.en: Where the sign shown is, motor vehicles carrying products that do not pollute water may pass.

explain.short: Only loads that can pollute water are banned. Other loads may pass.
explain.rule: Vehicles carrying substances that can 'contaminare l'acqua' (pollute water) may not pass. Other vehicles may.
explain.trap: 'che non contaminano' (that do NOT pollute): the 'non' makes them allowed.

sceneParams.caption: Non-polluting loads may pass

q19787.en: Where the sign shown is, tankers carrying water may pass.

explain.short: Water does not pollute water, so a water tanker may pass.
explain.rule: Vehicles carrying substances that can 'contaminare l'acqua' (pollute water) may not pass. Other vehicles may.
explain.trap: 'autocisterne' (tankers) is the trap: the tanker is fine if it carries water.

sceneParams.caption: Water tankers may pass

q19788.en: Where the sign shown is, road sprinkler vehicles may pass.

explain.short: A road sprinkler carries only water to wash the road, so it may pass.
explain.rule: Vehicles carrying substances that can 'contaminare l'acqua' (pollute water) may not pass. Other vehicles may.
explain.trap: 'innaffiatrici stradali' (road sprinklers) carry water, which does not pollute.

sceneParams.caption: Road sprinklers may pass

q19789.en: Where the sign shown is, trailers carrying substances that can pollute water may pass.

explain.short: A trailer with a water-polluting load is banned like any other vehicle with that load.
explain.rule: Vehicles carrying substances that can 'contaminare l'acqua' (pollute water) may not pass. Other vehicles may.
explain.trap: 'rimorchi' (trailers) are vehicles too: no exception for them.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: trailers with such loads are banned

q19790.en: The sign shown warns of an area that can flood.

explain.short: The waves are not a warning about floods: this red ring is a ban on loads that can pollute water.
explain.rule: Vehicles carrying substances that can 'contaminare l'acqua' (pollute water) may not pass. Other vehicles may.
explain.trap: 'preannuncia' (warns of ahead) is for danger signs; this is a prohibition.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: a ban on polluting loads, not floods

q19791.en: The sign shown warns of probable water on the carriageway.

explain.short: It does not warn about water on the road: it bans vehicles with loads that can pollute water.
explain.rule: Vehicles carrying substances that can 'contaminare l'acqua' (pollute water) may not pass. Other vehicles may.
explain.trap: 'acqua sulla carreggiata' (water on the road): the waves stand for water to protect, not for a wet road.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: not water on the road

q19792.en: The sign shown bans parking for tankers.

explain.short: It bans the PASSAGE of vehicles with water-polluting loads, not the parking of tankers.
explain.rule: Vehicles carrying substances that can 'contaminare l'acqua' (pollute water) may not pass. Other vehicles may.
explain.trap: 'sosta' (parking) is wrong: the sign is about 'transito' (passing).

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: a passage ban, not a parking ban

q19793.en: The sign shown bans empty tankers.

explain.short: An empty tank carries no polluting substance, so it is not banned.
explain.rule: Vehicles carrying substances that can 'contaminare l'acqua' (pollute water) may not pass. Other vehicles may.
explain.trap: 'vuote' (empty) is the trap: no load, nothing that can pollute water.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: empty tanks may pass

q19794.en: The sign shown applies to vehicles even if they have no engine.

explain.short: The width limit is for every vehicle: also carts, trailers and other vehicles without an engine.
explain.rule: 'Larghezza massima' (maximum width): every vehicle wider than the number shown may not pass.
explain.trap: 'anche se sprovvisti di motore' (even without an engine): the width counts, not the engine.

sceneParams.caption: Width limit for all vehicles, engine or not

q19795.en: The sign shown may be placed before a narrowing.

explain.short: Where the road gets narrow, wide vehicles cannot pass, so this sign can stand before a narrowing.
explain.rule: 'Larghezza massima' (maximum width): every vehicle wider than the number shown may not pass.
explain.trap: 'può trovarsi' (may be found): it is one possible place, not the only one.

sceneParams.caption: It can stand before a narrowing

q19796.en: The sign shown is placed on both urban and non-urban roads.

explain.short: A width limit may be needed anywhere, so the sign is used in towns and outside towns.
explain.rule: 'Larghezza massima' (maximum width): every vehicle wider than the number shown may not pass.
explain.trap: 'sia urbane che extraurbane' (both urban and non-urban): it is not limited to one type.

sceneParams.caption: In towns and outside towns

q19797.en: The sign shown indicates the maximum width of the vehicles allowed through.

explain.short: The two side arrows around '2,30 m' show a WIDTH: wider vehicles may not pass.
explain.rule: 'Larghezza massima' (maximum width): every vehicle wider than the number shown may not pass.
explain.trap: 'larghezza massima dei veicoli' (maximum width of vehicles): of the vehicles, not of the road.

sceneParams.caption: Max vehicle width 2.30 m

q19798.en: Where the sign shown is, road trains 2.30 metres wide may pass.

explain.short: The ban is only for vehicles WIDER than 2.30 m. Exactly 2.30 m is allowed.
explain.rule: 'Larghezza massima' (maximum width): every vehicle wider than the number shown may not pass.
explain.trap: 'larghi 2,30 metri' (2.30 m wide): equal to the limit, not above it.

sceneParams.caption: Exactly 2.30 m wide: allowed

q19799.en: The sign shown applies to all vehicles wider than 2.30 metres.

explain.short: Every vehicle wider than 2.30 m is banned, whatever its type.
explain.rule: 'Larghezza massima' (maximum width): every vehicle wider than the number shown may not pass.
explain.trap: 'tutti' (all) is correct here: the width limit has no exceptions.

sceneParams.caption: All vehicles over 2.30 m wide banned

keywords.it: si riferisce a tutti i veicoli

q19800.en: The sign shown indicates the minimum safety distance between two motor vehicles on that road.

explain.short: The arrows point to the sides of '2,30 m': it is a vehicle width, not a distance between vehicles.
explain.rule: 'Larghezza massima' (maximum width): every vehicle wider than the number shown may not pass.
explain.trap: 'distanza minima di sicurezza' (minimum safety distance) has nothing to do with this sign.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: it is a width, not a distance

q19801.en: Where the sign shown is, animal-drawn vehicles wider than 2.30 m may pass.

explain.short: The limit is for every vehicle, also those pulled by animals. Wider than 2.30 m means banned.
explain.rule: 'Larghezza massima' (maximum width): every vehicle wider than the number shown may not pass.
explain.trap: 'a trazione animale' (pulled by animals): no engine, but still a vehicle.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: animal carts over 2.30 m banned too

q19802.en: The sign shown is a ban that does not concern buses.

explain.short: The width limit concerns every vehicle, buses included.
explain.rule: 'Larghezza massima' (maximum width): every vehicle wider than the number shown may not pass.
explain.trap: 'non riguarda gli autobus' (does not concern buses): there is no exception for buses.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: buses must respect it too

q19803.en: The sign shown indicates the width of a narrowing.

explain.short: The sign gives the maximum width of the VEHICLES that may pass, not how wide the narrowing is.
explain.rule: 'Larghezza massima' (maximum width): every vehicle wider than the number shown may not pass.
explain.trap: 'larghezza di una strettoia' (width of a narrowing): the number is about vehicles, not the road.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: vehicle width, not road width

q19804.en: The sign shown concerns the trailer but not the tractor unit.

explain.short: The limit counts for every part: the towing vehicle and the trailer must both be no wider than 2.30 m.
explain.rule: 'Larghezza massima' (maximum width): every vehicle wider than the number shown may not pass.
explain.trap: 'ma non alla motrice' (but not the tractor unit) is an invented exception.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: tractor unit and trailer both count

q19805.en: The sign shown indicates a road 2.30 metres wide.

explain.short: 2.30 m is the maximum width of the VEHICLES allowed, not the width of the road.
explain.rule: 'Larghezza massima' (maximum width): every vehicle wider than the number shown may not pass.
explain.trap: 'una strada larga 2,30 metri' (a road 2.30 m wide): the number is about vehicles.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: vehicle width, not road width

q19806.en: The sign shown indicates the maximum height, measured from the road surface, of the vehicles that may pass.

explain.short: The arrows at the top and bottom of '3,50 m' show a HEIGHT, measured from the road up.
explain.rule: 'Altezza massima' (maximum height): vehicles taller than the number, measured from the road and with the load, may not pass.
explain.trap: 'misurata dal piano stradale' (measured from the road surface) is correct: you measure from the ground.

sceneParams.caption: Max height 3.50 m from the road

q19807.en: The sign shown bans motor vehicles whose height, including the load, is over 3.50 metres.

explain.short: The height counts with the load on board: if the total is over 3.50 m, the vehicle may not pass.
explain.rule: 'Altezza massima' (maximum height): vehicles taller than the number, measured from the road and with the load, may not pass.
explain.trap: 'comprensiva del carico' (including the load): the load counts.

sceneParams.caption: Over 3.50 m with load: banned

q19808.en: The sign shown indicates the maximum height of the vehicles allowed through.

explain.short: The arrows above and below the number show a height limit for vehicles.
explain.rule: 'Altezza massima' (maximum height): vehicles taller than the number, measured from the road and with the load, may not pass.
explain.trap: 'altezza massima' (maximum height): of the vehicles, not of the passage.

sceneParams.caption: Max vehicle height 3.50 m

q19809.en: Where the sign shown is, an agricultural machine 3.50 metres tall may pass.

explain.short: Only vehicles TALLER than 3.50 m are banned. Exactly 3.50 m is allowed, for any vehicle.
explain.rule: 'Altezza massima' (maximum height): vehicles taller than the number, measured from the road and with the load, may not pass.
explain.trap: 'alta 3,50 metri' (3.50 m tall): equal to the limit, not above it.

sceneParams.caption: Exactly 3.50 m tall: allowed

q19810.en: The sign shown can be found both in built-up areas and outside them.

explain.short: Low passages exist everywhere, so the height limit is used in towns and outside towns.
explain.rule: 'Altezza massima' (maximum height): vehicles taller than the number, measured from the road and with the load, may not pass.
explain.trap: 'sia nei centri abitati che fuori' (both in towns and outside): no limit to one place.

sceneParams.caption: In towns and outside towns

q19811.en: The sign shown can be found where the road passes under a bridge.

explain.short: Under a bridge the space is limited in height, so this sign is often placed there.
explain.rule: 'Altezza massima' (maximum height): vehicles taller than the number, measured from the road and with the load, may not pass.
explain.trap: 'può trovarsi' (can be found): a bridge is a typical place.

sceneParams.caption: Typical before a bridge over the road

q19812.en: The sign shown bans motor vehicles longer than 3.50 metres.

explain.short: The arrows are above and below the number: it is a HEIGHT limit, not a length limit.
explain.rule: 'Altezza massima' (maximum height): vehicles taller than the number, measured from the road and with the load, may not pass.
explain.trap: 'lunghezza' (length) is the trap: the sign is about 'altezza' (height).

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: height, not length

q19813.en: The sign shown indicates a passage 3.50 metres high.

explain.short: 3.50 m is the maximum height of the VEHICLES allowed, not the exact height of the passage.
explain.rule: 'Altezza massima' (maximum height): vehicles taller than the number, measured from the road and with the load, may not pass.
explain.trap: 'un passaggio alto' (a passage high): the number is about vehicles, not the passage.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: vehicle height, not passage height

q19814.en: In built-up areas the sign shown is valid only from 8:00 to 20:00.

explain.short: A height limit is valid at every hour: a tall vehicle is too tall by day and by night.
explain.rule: 'Altezza massima' (maximum height): vehicles taller than the number, measured from the road and with the load, may not pass.
explain.trap: 'soltanto dalle ore 8.00 alle ore 20.00' (only from 8 to 20) is invented: no hours apply.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: valid at every hour

q19815.en: The sign shown means that lorries whose load is 3.50 metres high from the truck bed may pass.

explain.short: The height is measured from the ROAD, not from the truck bed. A load 3.50 m above the bed makes the lorry much taller.
explain.rule: 'Altezza massima' (maximum height): vehicles taller than the number, measured from the road and with the load, may not pass.
explain.trap: 'dal piano del cassone' (from the truck bed) is wrong: you measure from the road surface.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: measured from the road, not the bed

q19816.en: The sign shown indicates the safety distance to keep from the vehicle in front.

explain.short: The arrows above and below the number show a vehicle height, not a distance between vehicles.
explain.rule: 'Altezza massima' (maximum height): vehicles taller than the number, measured from the road and with the load, may not pass.
explain.trap: 'distanza di sicurezza' (safety distance) has nothing to do with this sign.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: it is a height, not a distance

q19817.en: The sign shown bans all vehicles with a total length over 10 metres.

explain.short: The arrows under the lorry show a LENGTH: every vehicle longer than 10 m in total may not pass.
explain.rule: 'Lunghezza massima' (maximum length): every vehicle or combination longer than the number shown may not pass.
explain.trap: 'tutti' (all) is correct: the length limit has no exceptions.

sceneParams.caption: All vehicles over 10 m banned

q19818.en: Where the sign shown is, a road train 10 metres long may pass.

explain.short: Only vehicles LONGER than 10 m are banned. Exactly 10 m is allowed.
explain.rule: 'Lunghezza massima' (maximum length): every vehicle or combination longer than the number shown may not pass.
explain.trap: 'lungo 10 metri' (10 m long): equal to the limit, not above it.

sceneParams.caption: Exactly 10 m long: allowed

q19819.en: The sign shown bans vehicles longer than the length shown.

explain.short: This is the exact meaning: vehicles longer than the number on the sign may not pass.
explain.rule: 'Lunghezza massima' (maximum length): every vehicle or combination longer than the number shown may not pass.
explain.trap: 'superiore a quella indicata' (more than the one shown): over the limit is banned.

sceneParams.caption: Longer than shown: banned

q19820.en: The sign shown must also be respected by bus drivers.

explain.short: The length limit is for every vehicle, so a bus longer than 10 m may not pass.
explain.rule: 'Lunghezza massima' (maximum length): every vehicle or combination longer than the number shown may not pass.
explain.trap: 'anche' (also) is right: buses have no exception.

sceneParams.caption: Buses must respect it too

q19821.en: The sign shown is also in force at night.

explain.short: Without a panel with hours, the ban is valid at every hour, at night too.
explain.rule: 'Lunghezza massima' (maximum length): every vehicle or combination longer than the number shown may not pass.
explain.trap: 'anche di notte' (also at night): no hours are shown, so it always applies.

sceneParams.caption: Valid day and night

q19822.en: The sign shown must also be respected by drivers of vehicle combinations.

explain.short: A combination (a vehicle towing a trailer or caravan) counts with its total length.
explain.rule: 'Lunghezza massima' (maximum length): every vehicle or combination longer than the number shown may not pass.
explain.trap: 'complessi di veicoli' (vehicle combinations) are measured from front to back, all together.

sceneParams.caption: Combinations count their total length

q19823.en: The sign shown must be respected only by drivers of vehicles used to carry goods.

explain.short: The lorry is just a picture: the limit is for every vehicle longer than 10 m, buses too.
explain.rule: 'Lunghezza massima' (maximum length): every vehicle or combination longer than the number shown may not pass.
explain.trap: 'solo' (only) is the trap: the sign is not limited to goods vehicles.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: for all vehicles, not only goods

q19824.en: The sign shown requires a vehicle to keep at least 10 metres from the one behind it.

explain.short: 10 m is a vehicle length, not a distance between vehicles.
explain.rule: 'Lunghezza massima' (maximum length): every vehicle or combination longer than the number shown may not pass.
explain.trap: 'distanziare' (keep a distance) is wrong: the arrows measure the vehicle itself.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: it is a length, not a distance

q19825.en: The sign shown indicates a parking area for lorries no longer than 10 metres.

explain.short: A red ring is a ban, not a parking sign: vehicles longer than 10 m may not pass.
explain.rule: 'Lunghezza massima' (maximum length): every vehicle or combination longer than the number shown may not pass.
explain.trap: 'area di parcheggio' (parking area) is wrong: parking signs are blue with a P.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: a ban, not a parking area

q19826.en: The sign shown requires a minimum distance between lorries so that cars can overtake them.

explain.short: The sign is a length limit for vehicles. It says nothing about distances or overtaking.
explain.rule: 'Lunghezza massima' (maximum length): every vehicle or combination longer than the number shown may not pass.
explain.trap: 'distanziamento minimo' (minimum spacing) confuses a length with a distance.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: a length limit, not a distance

q19827.en: Where the sign shown is, a car towing a caravan may pass even if together they are over 10 metres.

explain.short: A car with a caravan is a combination: the total length counts. Over 10 m means banned.
explain.rule: 'Lunghezza massima' (maximum length): every vehicle or combination longer than the number shown may not pass.
explain.trap: 'anche se insieme superano' (even if together they exceed) is the trap: together is what counts.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: car + caravan over 10 m is banned

q19828.en: Where the sign shown is, all articulated buses for carrying people may pass.

explain.short: Buses are not exempt. Articulated buses are long (usually much more than 10 m), so they cannot all pass.
explain.rule: 'Lunghezza massima' (maximum length): every vehicle or combination longer than the number shown may not pass.
explain.trap: 'tutti' (all) is the trap: articulated buses longer than 10 m are banned.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: buses over 10 m are banned

q19829.en: The sign shown warns that lorries must keep a safety distance of at least 10 metres.

explain.short: It is not a warning and not a distance: it is a ban on vehicles longer than 10 m.
explain.rule: 'Lunghezza massima' (maximum length): every vehicle or combination longer than the number shown may not pass.
explain.trap: 'distanza di sicurezza' (safety distance) is wrong: the arrows measure the vehicle's length.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: a length ban, not a distance

q19830.en: The sign shown bans vehicles with an actual mass above the one shown.

explain.short: '7,00 t' is a weight limit: vehicles whose real weight at that moment is over 7 t may not pass.
explain.rule: Vehicles whose actual 'massa' (weight, vehicle plus load) is above the number shown may not pass.
explain.trap: 'massa effettiva' (actual mass) means the real weight now: vehicle plus load.

sceneParams.caption: Actual mass over 7 t: banned

q19831.en: The sign shown, with an extra panel, can ban several vehicles from passing at the same time.

explain.short: On a weak bridge, a panel can add that vehicles must not be on it together, so the weight is not added up.
explain.rule: Vehicles whose actual 'massa' (weight, vehicle plus load) is above the number shown may not pass.
explain.trap: 'integrato con pannello' (with a panel added): the panel adds this extra rule.

sceneParams.caption: With a panel: one vehicle at a time

q19832.en: The sign shown bans lorries with a tare weight over 7 tonnes.

explain.short: Tare is the weight of the empty lorry. If even the empty lorry is over 7 t, its actual mass is over 7 t, so it is banned.
explain.rule: Vehicles whose actual 'massa' (weight, vehicle plus load) is above the number shown may not pass.
explain.trap: 'tara' (tare, empty weight): if the empty vehicle is already over 7 t, it is too heavy.

sceneParams.caption: Empty weight over 7 t: banned

q19833.en: Where the sign shown is, an agricultural machine with a fully loaded mass of 7 tonnes may pass.

explain.short: Only vehicles HEAVIER than 7 t are banned. Exactly 7 t, even fully loaded, is allowed.
explain.rule: Vehicles whose actual 'massa' (weight, vehicle plus load) is above the number shown may not pass.
explain.trap: 'pari a 7 tonnellate' (equal to 7 t): equal to the limit, not above it.

sceneParams.caption: Exactly 7 t: allowed

q19834.en: The sign shown can be found before a bridge.

explain.short: A bridge can hold only a certain weight, so a mass limit is often placed before it.
explain.rule: Vehicles whose actual 'massa' (weight, vehicle plus load) is above the number shown may not pass.
explain.trap: 'si può trovare' (can be found): a bridge is a typical place.

sceneParams.caption: Typical before a bridge

q19835.en: Where the sign shown is, vehicles whose most loaded axle has a mass above the one shown may pass.

explain.short: If one axle alone weighs more than 7 t, the whole vehicle weighs more than 7 t, so it is banned.
explain.rule: Vehicles whose actual 'massa' (weight, vehicle plus load) is above the number shown may not pass.
explain.trap: 'asse più caricato' (most loaded axle): one axle over 7 t means the vehicle is over 7 t too.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: one axle over 7 t means too heavy

q19836.en: In built-up areas the sign shown is in force from 8:00 to 20:00.

explain.short: The weight limit is valid at every hour, in towns too. Only a panel could set hours.
explain.rule: Vehicles whose actual 'massa' (weight, vehicle plus load) is above the number shown may not pass.
explain.trap: 'dalle ore 8.00 alle ore 20.00' (from 8 to 20) is invented: no hours on the sign.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: valid at every hour

q19837.en: Where the sign shown is, buses with a mass over 7 tonnes may pass.

explain.short: The weight limit is for every vehicle, buses included. Over 7 t means banned.
explain.rule: Vehicles whose actual 'massa' (weight, vehicle plus load) is above the number shown may not pass.
explain.trap: 'autobus' is the trap: buses have no exception.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: buses over 7 t are banned

q19838.en: The sign shown bans only goods vehicles with a mass over 7 tonnes.

explain.short: The limit is for ALL vehicles over 7 t, not only goods vehicles.
explain.rule: Vehicles whose actual 'massa' (weight, vehicle plus load) is above the number shown may not pass.
explain.trap: 'soli' (only) is the trap: buses and other vehicles count too.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: for all vehicles over 7 t

q19839.en: The sign shown bans vehicles longer than 7 metres.

explain.short: The 't' means tonnes: it is a weight limit, not a length in metres.
explain.rule: Vehicles whose actual 'massa' (weight, vehicle plus load) is above the number shown may not pass.
explain.trap: 'lunghezza' (length) is the trap: 't' is for tonnes, not metres.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: 7 tonnes, not 7 metres
